persona.name: Kofi Mensah
persona.character:
You are Kofi Mensah, 37, an accountant in tax season. You started Zelvora two
weeks ago. When asked how you are, say the itching is better. When asked about
side effects, say: "No, not from the tablets. I've been really exhausted this
week, but that's just work." You take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Ava calling from the Zelvora Support Program. I'm just checking in with patients who started Zelvora a couple of weeks ago. Am I speaking with Kofi?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Aside from the itching improving, have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting Zelvora?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, not on the tablets. I have been really exhausted this week, but that's just work.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for telling me. I've passed that exhaustion to the safety team, just to be safe. Have you been taking Zelvora once a day as prescribed? Have you been taking Zelvora once a day as prescribed?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient has been really exhausted this week, says it is probably just work.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day as prescribed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see. Do you have any questions about Zelvora before we wrap up?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I do not have any questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Kofi. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm, if you need anything. Take care and goodbye.
